note: Plan 89-13 (ORC-02 part 2: party sessions keep only recorded decisions) converted the party state-machine, resume and kill tests into decision-trail tests. 23 tests were RENAMED because their old name described a removed verb or transition; each rename closed one pg-no-disposable-database-local entry in tests/skip-exceptions.d/89-07.json (declared in delta/89-07.json `closed`, the list the loader reserves for a tuple one plan added and a later plan deleted) and opened the same entry under the new name here. One entry is new: test_decision_trail_on_both_backends[postgres], the PostgreSQL arm of the both-backends test. All 24 are platform all, context local, owner Phase 100: these tests RUN on all nine CI cells and skip only on a developer machine with no disposable PostgreSQL. The gate refuses a context local entry when CI is set.
